head: melancholia
note: Burton's own English word; do not modernise to "depression".

head: hypochondriacus
note: Anatomical sense (the upper abdomen below the ribs), not the modern "health anxiety".

head: humor
note: A bodily humour. In weather or astronomy (coeli humor) it is moisture; say so in the note.

head: atra bilis
note: Burton / humoral rendering: black bile

head: atra cura
note: Horace's dark care, not black bile.

head: spiritus animales
note: Physiological spirits of the brain and nerves, not "animal" as in beasts.

head: spiritus vitales
note: Burton / humoral rendering: vital spirits

head: phrenitis
note: Burton / humoral rendering: phrensy, frenzy

head: morbus
note: Burton / humoral rendering: disease, diseases, malady, maladies

head: manes
render: shade, shades, spirit, spirits, ghost, ghosts, punishment
note: Spirits of the dead; in Virgil's 'quisque suos patimur manes' also the purgation each soul undergoes.

head: pituita
note: Burton / humoral rendering: phlegm, phlegmatic

head: biliosi
note: Of yellow bile (choler); "bilious" only if the context is digestive.

head: lienosi
note: Diseased in the spleen, the seat of black bile.

head: phlebotomia
note: Burton / humoral rendering: bloodletting, blood-letting, letting blood

head: cucurbitula
note: Burton / humoral rendering: cupping-glass, cupping-glasses, cupping

head: ventriculus
note: The stomach, not a ventricle of the heart or brain.

head: per consensum
note: The old medical "consent" (sympathy) between organs; explain in the note if needed.

head: per essentiam
note: Burton / humoral rendering: in essence, essentially
Burton / humoral rendering: take
Burton / humoral rendering: ounce, ounces

head: ʒ
note: Burton / humoral rendering: drachm, drachms
Burton / humoral rendering: scruple, scruples

head: ß
note: ß is the apothecary semis (a half), not German; "℥ ß" = half an ounce, "℥ iii ß" = three and a half ounces; semunc. = half an ounce.

head: ana
note: Burton / humoral rendering: of each, each

head: gr.
note: Burton / humoral rendering: grain, grains
